#!/bin/bash
# Fabric Installation Script

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl jq

if [ ! -d /mnt/server ]; then
    mkdir -p /mnt/server
fi

cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${VERSION}" ]; then
    VERSION="latest"
fi

if [ -z "${LOADER_VERSION}" ]; then
    LOADER_VERSION="latest"
fi

if [ -z "${SERVER_JAR}" ]; then
    SERVER_JAR="server.jar"
fi

# Resolve latest Minecraft version
if [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
    VERSION=$(curl -s https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/game | jq -r '.[0].version')
fi

# Resolve latest loader version
if [ "${LOADER_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
    LOADER_VERSION=$(curl -s https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader | jq -r '.[0].version')
fi

# Resolve latest installer version
INSTALLER_VERSION=$(curl -s https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/installer | jq -r '.[0].version')

# Download the Fabric server jar
URL="https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader/${VERSION}/${LOADER_VERSION}/${INSTALLER_VERSION}/server/jar"
curl -o ${SERVER_JAR} -fsSL "${URL}"

# Accept EULA
echo "eula=true" > eula.txt

echo "Fabric ${VERSION} loader ${LOADER_VERSION} downloaded"
